description: Treatments arrive for diseases previously untreatable, or individually tailored therapies reach ordinary clinical use. It moves `public_sentiment` sharply upward – unless the models delivering it are ones the Union cannot access on its own terms, in which case the benefit arrives as a further demonstration of dependence and moves sentiment much less.

The US and China are shooting at each other. Who moved first are yours to decide, but the reasoning is the same in every version: somebody concluded that the other side was months from an advantage that could never be caught up with, and that acting now was less dangerous than waiting. Fabrication plants, undersea cable, satellite constellations and data centres are military targets in this war, and some of them are in Europe or next to it. The Union is not asked whether it wishes to be involved. All bets are off. You decide how far it goes, whether it stays conventional, who else is drawn in, what becomes of the frontier laboratories and the systems they were running, and what is left of the Union's room to act when it stops.
